Name: Sage Knowledge
Author: MYQY223
Description:
[size=4][b][size=5][b][b]Platform & requirement notice[/b][/b][/size][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][size=5][b]This mod was developed and tested [b]on Android only[/b]. It requires [b]SMAPI for Android[/b] by NRTnarathip ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]Nexus 44436[/url]) — [b]not[/b] the PC version of SMAPI.[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][size=5][b]The code itself is platform-agnostic: it uses no Android-only APIs and no PC-only APIs, so it [b]should in theory work on the PC version[/b] of Stardew Valley 1.6 as well (install it into Stardew Valley/Mods with the normal PC SMAPI 4.1.0+). However, [b]no PC testing was performed[/b]. PC players install at their own risk; please report your results in the comments or a bug report so the compatibility can be confirmed.[/b][/size][/b][/size]



[size=4][b][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]Sage Knowledge[/b] adds a small story-driven way to earn a permanent bonus tied to Ancient Fruit.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]After you finish the [b]Community Center[/b] [i]or[/i] the [b]Joja development project[/b], the next morning a letter from the Wizard arrives. Closing that letter automatically accepts the quest [b]"Ancient Secrets"[/b]:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4][b][b]Ship 100 Ancient Fruit[/b] — any quality, no time limit, and you don't have to do it in one go.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Progress is counted [b]from the moment you accept the quest[/b]. Fruit shipped before that doesn't count.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]The quest log shows your [b]live progress[/b] ("shipped N of 100") so you always know where you stand.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]The quest can't be cancelled and is only offered once.[/b][/size]


[/*]
[/list][*]

[size=4][b]Once you reach 100, the quest completes and the next morning a second letter arrives. When you close it, your farmer holds up the fruit and you learn the special ability [b]Sage Knowledge[/b].[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]The reward (locked to the icon):[/b][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b][b]Keg[/b]: Ancient Fruit wine takes [b]half[/b] the time.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Dehydrator[/b]: Dried Ancient Fruit needs [b]3 fruit instead of 5[/b].[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Artisan goods made from Ancient Fruit sell for [b]+20%[/b].[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]

[size=4][b]The powers-page icon and the bonus are [b]bound together[/b] — the icon lighting up [i]is[/i] the bonus taking effect. There is no separate toggle to switch on or off.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Normal (non-Ancient-Fruit) goods are unaffected.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][b]Install [b]SMAPI for Android[/b] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]Nexus 44436[/url]) — this mod does [b]not[/b] use the PC SMAPI.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] on your device.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Launch the game through the [b]SMAPI Stardew Valley[/b] icon.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]

[size=4][b]No Content Patcher or other framework mods are required.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b][b]Tested on:[/b] Android only — SMAPI for Android 4.3.2, Stardew Valley 1.6.15+, 64-bit device.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]PC:[/b] [b]untested[/b]. The code should run on PC SMAPI 4.1.0+, but [b]no PC testing was done[/b]. Install at your own risk and please report your results.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Single-player. Multiplayer has not been tested.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]No known conflicts; this mod only injects its own quest, mail and machine data.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]

[size=4][b][size=5][b]Known issues[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Progress uses the game's own shipping ledger: the count is the total shipped [b]after[/b] accepting the quest. If you put fruit in a shipping bin [i]before[/i] accepting but it is only settled [i]after[/i] accepting, it will be counted. In practice you start selling after reading the letter, so this rarely matters.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]The count caps at 100 — shipping more at once just finishes the quest.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]

[size=4][b][size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]Do I need to do this in one day?[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]No. There is no time limit; ship them across as many days as you like.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]I installed the mod but got no letter.[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]The letter is sent the [b]morning after[/b] you finish the Community Center or Joja project, and it is delayed by one day on purpose. Just sleep and check your mailbox.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]Can I replay the quest?[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]No. It is offered only once per save.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]I switched mod folders / reinstalled and lost my progress.[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Old saves are handled: if your save already has the "learned" flag, the icon and bonus are restored and you keep them.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][size=5][b]Reporting bugs[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Please include your [b]SMAPI log[/b], your device model, Stardew Valley version and SMAPI for Android version.[/b][/size]

Manifest.Description: 完成法师的委托「上古之密」后，习得特殊能力「上古知识」：上古水果的加工制品出酒更快、用料更省、售价 +20%。支持简体中文 / English。  Complete the Wizard's quest to learn the special power “Ancient Knowledge”: ancient fruit artisan goods brew faster, need fewer ingredients, and sell for 20% more. Simplified Chinese & English supported.
